text: Deutsche Bank raised its price target on Charles Schwab (SCHW) to $128 from $121 while maintaining its Buy rating, signaling continued confidence in the stock's upside potential. This new target sits notably above the current analyst consensus, where the stock holds an average "overweight" rating and a mean price target of $112.65, according to FactSet-polled analysts. Deutsche Bank's more bullish stance suggests it sees greater growth or valuation upside than the broader analyst community. Investors may view this as a positive signal, though it's worth noting the target remains an outlier relative to peer estimates, warranting attention to the bank's underlying rationale.
